messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR #4820 merged but noticed the model catalog examples still show two different patterns for embedding vs text generation. Can we align before we publish the updated cards? https://github.com/redwood-inference/pulse/pull/4820 :eyes:

alex: Oh thanks, I saw that. The embed example uses the old 'embed' payload shape, the generate example uses the new streaming payload. Users will be confused about which SDK params to use.

jen: Quick note: embedding requests need the shorter max_input_tokens check in the model card because we truncate differently. Suggest we add a short migration snippet showing both calls side-by-side and a comment about token accounting.

maya: Agreed. Proposed placement: model-card -> Examples -> "Embedding vs Generation" collapsible. Keep both a minimal curl/jsonrest example and one SDK v2 snippet.

alex: Draft SDK v2 snippet (feel free to edit):
```js
// embedding (SDK v2)
const emb = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: "vega-embed-001",
  input: "How many tokens in this sentence?"
});

// generation (SDK v2)
const out = await client.responses.create({
  model: "aurora-13b",
  input: "Write a 4-line haiku about caching",
  max_output_tokens: 48
});
```

jen: Perfect. Add a small note above the embed snippet: "For models where max_input_tokens < 2048, prefix-truncation is applied; verify token counts with tokenizers.encode(...) before sending large batches."

tomas: I can take the PR to update the catalog card. Two quick Qs: (1) Do we keep the old curl examples for backwards compatibility? (2) Do we add a tiny bench result next to the example (e.g., 1.8 ms/token on n1)?

maya: (1) Yes, keep curl but mark as legacy and link to migration subsection. (2) Bench snippet is helpful — add a single-line result with a link to the benchmark run. Avoid large tables in the card.

doc-bot: link-checker: found broken link in model/aurora-13b/benchmarks -> /bench/runs/9987 (404). Please update to /bench/runs/10011 or remove.

alex: I'll update the bench link in the PR to run 10011. Tomas, please add the migration subheading and the curl legacy snippet. Jen, can you add the short token accounting blurb?

jen: On it. Also will include a tiny helper showing how to compute token usage in Python and JS.

tomas: I'll open a small docs PR (#4832) with the card edits and both snippets. Pinging for review once up.

maya: Thanks — checklist for the PR: 
- [ ] unify examples (embed + generate)
- [ ] add SDK v2 snippets + curl legacy note
- [ ] token accounting blurb + small helper code
- [ ] update bench link to 10011 and one-line perf note
- [ ] add migration note in model catalog index

alex: Sounds good. Please tag me for review, will do a quick pass for accuracy. :thumbsup:

jen: Will also run eslint/format on snippets and include fenced code language labels.

doc-bot: deploy-preview: docs preview for branch docs/4832 is ready at https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/preview/4832

maya: Nice — I'll skim the preview before we merge. Thanks all! :tada:
